description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
